content: Thank you, 5DN1L, I have fixed those errors, and I will continue to refine the clash.

Goal
* Please add "<<This clash is in Reverse mode only>>" at the beginning.

* Please remove the note.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Cases
* The constraint states that -10000 ≤ N ≤ 10000, but the current test cases don't cover the full range evenly:

  • Tests: All inputs are between -10 and 10.

  • Validators: All inputs are 4-digit integers, either positive or negative.

  Please add cases that ensures comprehensive and balanced coverage across all magnitudes.

Thanks.
I am the creator of this Clash, and I appreciate any feedback that could help improve it. Thanks!

Thank you too.

Please ensure that each test and its corresponding validator have matching parity. For example, if [[N]] in the test is odd, then [[N]] in the validator should also be odd.

The input value coverage also needs improvement. For example,

* There is only one two-digit [[N]] across all cases.

* No negative four-digit [[N]] values are used in any validators.
Thanks! I think I fixed the parities and the biased distribution of 2 digit numbers.
The parities don't seem to be consistent yet. For example, Test 1 has an even input, whereas Validator 1 has an odd input.
